description: Screen up to 50 names against the sanctions lists in ONE call (POST /sanctions/screen). Requires the sanctions scope (batch calls do not use the free trial allowance); every item costs 3 credits, an item that errs or times out nothing. Per-item status: match / clear / error / timeout. "clear" means no hit whose match_score reached the threshold on the active lists, not a certification. match_score is the best of the listed name and every alias, read both ways: 100 the same name; 80-99 one holds every word of the other, in any order; up to 95 a close spelling; under 80 a word that only begins a longer word (SEAT in SEATTLE). Candidates are found 20 points under the threshold (never under 30); one under 80 by name similarity reaches 80 only as a spelling of the listed name, word for word (Ramzan Kadirov finds Ramzan Kadyrov), not as a look-alike (Iberia: SIBERIA 78). Optional idempotency_key: replaying the same key with the same items within 24h returns the original response for free (409 if still running, 422 if the items differ).

group.description: entity: one row per listed person/company with lists[] and sources[] instead of one row per source list.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Safe-replay key for this exact batch (1-255 printable ASCII); a repeat within 24h is free and returns the stored result.

list.description: Comma-separated source lists to restrict to, e.g. OFAC,EU,UN.

threshold.description: Minimum match_score a hit must reach, 30-100 (default 80): 100 the same name; 80-99 one holds every word of the other; up to 95 a close spelling; under 80 a word that only begins a longer word (SEAT in SEATTLE). Lower it to 50-60 to catch more spelling variants.

name: sanctions_screen_batch
title: Bulk sanctions screening
